plain.li: Somebody has to know which field wants resting and which wants turnips. I've been that somebody for a year, without the chair.
[inherited] {NAME} walked the fields every morning before anyone else was up. I'll {GOAL}, and keep the walk going.
[spark:seat:harvest] I brought in more of the harvest than anyone this year. Next year I'd like to decide what goes in the ground.
[lowtech] The fields have always had a keeper, where I come from. Ours have a lot of people who mean well.

warm.li: I love the fields, and I'd like the colony to trust me with them. I'll {GOAL} if they'll have me.

blunt.li: I know the soil here better than anyone. Give me the seat.

cold.li: Our yields are poor because nobody plans the rotation. As reeve I would.

plain.li: Reeve. I walked every field at first light this morning, the same as yesterday, except now it's my job.
They made me reeve. The first thing I did was count the seed. The second was count it again.

cheerful.li: Reeve! I've already planned three seasons of planting in my head.

gloomy.li: Reeve now. When the blight comes, they'll all look at me.

plain.li: I sat two of them down this week who hadn't spoken in a month, and by supper they were passing each other the salt. Somebody ought to do that on purpose.
[inherited] {NAME} could end a shouting match with one look. I can't do the look yet, but I'll {GOAL} and learn it.
[spark:seat:mended] I mended a quarrel today that wasn't mine to mend. Next time I'd like it to be.

warm.li: Nobody here should go to bed angry at a neighbour. I'd like to be the one who sees that they don't.

blunt.li: Too much shouting in this colony. Make me peacemaker and there'll be less of it.

cold.li: Every feud costs us work. As peacemaker I would end them faster.

plain.li: Peacemaker. Two people came to me before breakfast, both sure the other was wrong. It's going to be like this, isn't it.

warm.li: They trust me to keep the peace. I'll try to deserve that every day.

gloomy.li: Peacemaker now, so every quarrel is partly mine.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: the keeper of days' seat
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: serve as the colony's keeper of days
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: served as the colony's keeper of days

plain.li: I remembered the founding day this year before anyone else did, and the harvest home, and somebody's birthday the rest forgot. I could keep the colony's days properly.
[inherited] {NAME} knew every day worth keeping and why. I'll {GOAL}, so none of them are lost.
[spark:seat:daykept] We kept a day together this week, and it was me who saw it through. I'd like to see them all through.

warm.li: Our days are what we'll remember of this place. Somebody should look after them, and I'd like it to be me.

cheerful.li: Keeper of days! Somebody has to remind everyone it's a feast, and I never forget a feast.

cold.li: The calendar is kept carelessly. A keeper of days would end that.

plain.li: Keeper of days. I've written the year's days out on the wall in order. People keep stopping to read it.

warm.li: They gave me the colony's days to look after. I won't let one of them slip by.

gloomy.li: Keeper of days. Now when a day's forgotten, it's me who forgot it.

plain.li: The animals come to me before they come to anyone, and I know which of them is off its feed before it does. I should have the herd.
[inherited] {NAME} knew every beast in the pens by name. I'll {GOAL}, and learn the names {NAME} knew.
[spark:seat:tamed] I brought a wild one in this week, with nothing but patience and a pocket of feed. I'd like the whole herd in my care.

warm.li: The animals need someone who'll look after them first and count them second. I'd like to be that someone.

blunt.li: I'm the best with the animals here. Make me herdmaster.

cold.li: The herd is managed by whoever happens to be passing. As herdmaster I would plan its breeding properly.

plain.li: Herdmaster. I went out to the pens and told them. They didn't seem surprised.

cheerful.li: Herdmaster! Every animal in the colony is mine to look after now, and I mean every one.

gloomy.li: Herdmaster now. When we have to slaughter, I'll be the one choosing.

plain.li: I stood at the front of the rite this week and said the words, and people listened. I'd like to be the one who says them every time.
[inherited] {NAME} sat with every grieving soul in this colony. I'll {GOAL} and sit where {NAME} sat.
[spark:seat:riteled] Leading the rite felt like something I was meant to do. The chaplain's seat would let me do it properly.

warm.li: When someone's faith wears thin, they should have somebody to talk to. I'd like to be that somebody.

cold.li: The faith holds the colony together. It deserves someone who takes it seriously.

plain.li: Chaplain. I led the evening's words and my voice only shook once.

warm.li: They gave me the faith to look after, and everyone in it. I'll keep my door open.

gloomy.li: Chaplain now. Every funeral is mine to speak at.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: the warden of guests' seat
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: serve as the colony's warden of guests
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: served as the colony's warden of guests

plain.li: I walked down to the camp by the road this week and sat at their fire, and they told me where they'd come from. Somebody should do that every time.
[inherited] {NAME} met every stranger at the gate as if they were expected. I'll {GOAL} and keep the gate that way.
[spark:seat:greeted] The travellers by the road went away thinking well of us, and I think I had something to do with it. I'd like the seat for it.

warm.li: Everyone who comes up our road should be welcomed properly. I'd like that to be my work.

cheerful.li: Warden of guests! I'd meet every caravan with a cup in my hand.

cold.li: How we treat visitors decides how the region treats us. The warden's seat matters more than people think.

plain.li: Warden of guests. The next traveller at the gate gets a proper welcome, and I've already decided what I'll say.

warm.li: They made me warden of guests. Nobody will come up our road and feel unwelcome now.

gloomy.li: Warden now. When a guest causes trouble, it'll be me who let them in.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: an elder's seat
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: take an elder's seat on the council
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: took an elder's seat on the council

plain.li: I've lived long enough to have seen most of our mistakes made once already. The council could use somebody who remembers.
[inherited] {NAME} was the one the children went to with their questions. I'll {GOAL}, and keep answering them.
[spark:seat:taught] The one I taught can manage without me now. I'd like to teach more than one at a time.
[spark:birth] There's a new child in the colony, and somebody should be there to tell the little one how all this began. I'd like a seat for it.

warm.li: I'd like to sit with the young ones and tell them what I know, before I forget it.

cold.li: Experience is wasted if nobody asks for it. An elder's seat would make sure they ask.

plain.li: An elder of the council now. I said one thing at the meeting and they all went quiet to listen. I could get used to that.

warm.li: They gave me an elder's seat. I'll try to give them better advice than I was given.

gloomy.li: An elder's seat. That's a polite word for old, but I'll take it.
